params.prompt: Stylized blocky Roblox-style cartoon game UI concept art, 16:9 landscape phone game screen, matte flat colors, thick dark outlines, rounded panels, sticker-like cards, chunky bold readable text. Strictly NO neon, NO glow, NO bloom, NO lens flare, NO emissive light, NO glossy shine. Heist-comedy tone, kid-friendly, no blood, no weapons shown. Reward state system: 7 days; claimed days have a green check stamp, today is highlighted with a dark outline and a TODAY pill, locked days have a padlock pill. Includes a close X button top-right, a streak counter, and one big CLAIM button. Title lockup 'GETAWAY ROUTE'. Scene: flat top-down blueprint-style map of a blocky Brickell-style city (blue paper, white line art). A small cartoon go-kart drives along a dotted route through 7 numbered stash-spot pins (days 1-7) in squad colors sky blue, orange, green, pink-purple. Days 1-3 pins have green check stamps, day 4 pin is TODAY with the kart on it, days 5-6 are blocked by a cartoon patrol drone with a flat translucent vision-cone wedge (no glow) and a padlock pill, day 7 is a tall tower labeled VAULT. Bottom-left clipboard card 'DAY 4 REWARD: Wheel Spin Ticket' with a big 'CLAIM' button. '3 DAY STREAK' as a route-progress pill.
